title: FitMint
tagline: A 7 minute A.I generated workout app that mints NFTs upon completing workouts
description:
FitMint is a unique and innovative fitness app that combines the benefits of working out with the excitement of NFTs. This 7-minute workout app is designed to help users stay fit and healthy while also earning rewards in the form of NFTs.

FitMint offers a variety of high-intensity interval training (HIIT) workouts that are tailored to target different muscle groups and are perfect for people with busy schedules who want to maximize their workout time. These workouts consist of bodyweight exercises that can be done anywhere, without the need for any equipment.

One of the key features of FitMint is the NFT reward system. Users can earn NFTs by completing workouts and tracking their progress. These NFTs are unique digital tokens that can be collected, traded, and even sold. They serve as a tangible representation of the user's hard work and dedication to their fitness goals.

In addition to earning NFTs, FitMint also includes a comprehensive tracking system that allows users to monitor their progress, set personal goals, and track their fitness stats. The app also includes a social feature that enables users to connect with other FitMint users, share their progress, and encourage each other to reach their fitness goals.

With FitMint, users can enjoy a fun and effective workout experience while also earning NFTs that they can keep as a reminder of their achievements. Whether you're a seasoned fitness enthusiast or just starting out, FitMint is the perfect app for anyone looking to get fit and healthy in just 7 minutes a day.
how_its_made:
A React Native app using Ethers.js and Web3 authentication to create an NFT minting workout mobile app would use a combination of popular web development technologies to create a cross-platform mobile application.

React Native is a popular framework for building mobile apps using JavaScript and React, a JavaScript library for building user interfaces. It allows developers to build apps that run on both iOS and Android with a single codebase.

Ethers.js is a JavaScript library for Ethereum that makes it easy for developers to interact with the Ethereum blockchain and perform operations such as sending transactions and reading data from smart contracts.

By combining these technologies, developers can create a mobile app that allows users to perform NFT minting through workout activities. The app would interact with a smart contract on the Ethereum blockchain to mint new NFTs and store them in the user's Web3 authenticated wallet. The React Native framework would be used to create a user-friendly and performant mobile app with a custom user interface.
